_note: The wall the WALL hack puts up (src/game/walls.ts): its panel and how far ahead of you it goes, in metres. These were WARD's in the legacy game's kits.json, which went in Milestone 491 with the kits; the hack kept them. How long it stands, its cooldown and how many stand at once are the hack's own (hacks.json wall).
_piece: A panel put up at an angle collides as short pieces along it, each the box round its piece, at most this long, in metres; one square to the world's axes is one box, exactly the panel. As one box round it, a panel at 45 degrees was up to 3.2 m square: it stopped rounds 2.3 m in front of the panel and behind it, and could take in the one who put it up, who was shoved out of it (Milestone 894). Ours.
